name: Daily Sales Report from POS to Google Sheets and Telegram

parameters.content:
## Daily Sales Report (Indonesia POS)

### Features:
- Auto-runs at 9 PM daily (closing time)
- Fetches from POS API (adaptable to Moka, Majoo, iReap, etc.)
- Calculates: gross/net sales, discounts, PPN
- Payment breakdown: Tunai, Debit/Card, QRIS/GoPay/OVO/DANA/ShopeePay
- Top 5 best-selling products
- Saves to Google Sheets + sends Telegram summary

### Configuration:
1. Replace POS API URL (Moka: api.mokapos.com, Majoo: api.majoo.id, etc.)
2. Set Telegram Bot Token + Chat ID
3. Configure Google Sheets document
